messages:
Nadia P: Kickoff: running a 2-week Passport Rapid Triage sprint for customers flagged at "renewal-risk". Short 25m slots to clear migration + infra blockers, capture renewal intent, and route follow-ups. Signup: https://tiny.redwood/passport-sprint :rocket:

Jon H: I like 25m — forces focus. I'm available Mon/Wed mornings PT. Do we want an intake form to surface perms + stack?

Sofia L: Yes please. Minimal intake: 1) org name, 2) primary contact, 3) current env (cloud/on-prem), 4) short description of blocker. Keep single-line answers.

Ravi M: Ops asks we limit to 4 orgs per slot. Also recommend reserving the last slot each week for "deep escalations" (internal).

Nadia P: Agreed on capacity. Plan: 3 public slots/day, 4 seats each; 1 weekly reserved deep slot. I'll add capacity math to the signup sheet.

Jon H: Formula to show free seats: `=IF(C2-COUNTIF(AttendeesRange,"yes")>0, C2-COUNTIF(AttendeesRange,"yes"), 0)` — C2=capacity.

Sofia L: Draft host guide (will PR to docs):
```
- 0-3m: quick intros, confirm access method (SSH/console/API)
- 3-15m: narrow down repro, check logs, attempt quick mitigation
- 15-22m: show playbook steps, schedule follow-up if needed
- 22-25m: capture customer sentiment + renewal likelihood, close with next owner
```

Nadia P: For sentiment capture use short question on the form: "How confident are you we'll resolve this in the next 7 days? (1-5)". Also ask "Would you like a follow-up RFC? (Y/N)"

forms-bot: form.create -> id=fm_passport_2026; fields=[org, contact, env, blocker_short, confidence_1to5, followup_yesno] :white_check_mark:

Ravi M: Can we auto-tag accounts in CS dashboard when they register (tag=passport-sprint)? That'll help routing + CSM visibility.

Sofia L: Yes. Also add a field to record "last touch" and "renewal quarter" so PMs can see correlation.

Jon H: Scheduling: let's reuse one global Zoom link for public slots and a separate link for the reserved deep slot. Rotation: Nadia/Jon/Sofia host main slots; Ravi covers deep slot. Note: disable waiting room and enable co-hosts.

ops-bot: calendar.create -> event_group=passport_sprint_slots; recurrence=Mon-Fri; times=[09:00PT,11:00PT,15:00PT]; hosts=[Nadia P, Jon H, Sofia L] :white_check_mark:

Nadia P: Follow-ups: Priortize follow-up tasks into a triage board with columns: To Investigate, Actionable Fix, Needs Engineering, Customer Follow-up. We'll create issue templates for each.

Sofia L: Feedback capture (post-session): 1) Did the session resolve your blocker? (Y/N) 2) Remaining concerns (short) 3) Renewal sentiment (1-5). Keep it under 3 questions. We'll trigger a Slack alert if sentiment <= 2.

Jon H: I'll add a small sheet that tallies resolution rate by day and flags customers with unresolved blockers older than 3 days.

Ravi M: Ops note: add a short "pre-check" checklist link in the signup confirmation so customers can run quick diagnostics before the slot. That saves time.

Nadia P: I'll assemble the pre-check + pasteable command snippets and link them in the form confirmation. Also creating a template follow-up email for cases needing SRE/Eng.

Sofia L: One more ask: can we surface whether the account is on Dedicated or Private? That changes runbook steps. Add that to the intake form (single-select).

forms-bot: form.update -> id=fm_passport_2026; add_field=deployment_type (hosted/dedicated/private) :white_check_mark:

Nadia P: OK timeline: final form + sheet + calendar live by end of day Friday. Sprint start next Monday. I'll post links here when live. Thanks team. :tada:
